description:
PKIX-fmtv.18.6's diff against 'openssl verify -purpose timestampsign' surfaced a real divergence: OpenSSL strictly enforces RFC 3161 §2.3, requiring the TSA cert's KeyUsage to contain ONLY 'digitalSignature' and/or 'nonRepudiation'. Other bits (keyEncipherment, keyAgreement, etc.) trigger 'unsuitable certificate purpose' rejection.

pkix-chain's verify_time_stamper does NOT check KU shape — only EKU presence, criticality, and sole-EKU. The fixture 'leaf-timestamping.der' (authored by pyca's gen.py for the smoke surface) carries digitalSignature+keyEncipherment in KU, validates under verify_time_stamper, and fails 'openssl verify -purpose timestampsign'.

Two parts to address:

(1) **Strengthen verify_time_stamper or BasicTimeStampingProfile** to enforce RFC 3161 §2.3: TSA cert KU MUST be limited to digitalSignature and/or nonRepudiation. Surface as Error::ProfileViolation. Pkix-path may not have a 'forbidden KU bit' check today; if not, the wrapper layer is the right place.

(2) **Regenerate leaf-timestamping.der** to comply with RFC 3161 §2.3 KU shape (drop keyEncipherment). Update gen.py to produce TSA fixtures with the correct KU. Once shipped, the pkix-difftest baseline-verify-openssl.md row 'happy_path_rfc3161_ku_violation' flips to Agree, the known_divergence flag is removed, and the bead is closed.

Acceptance:
- verify_time_stamper rejects leaf-timestamping.der under BasicTimeStampingProfile due to KU shape (after fixture-update or instead of). Test added under pkix-chain/tests/verify_time_stamper.rs.
- baseline-verify-openssl.md timestamp section shows 4/4 agree, 0 known divergence.
title: verify_time_stamper should enforce RFC 3161 §2.3 KeyUsage shape
